provenance: Full-text ordinances from berkeleyca.gov (Berkeley_*Full Text.pdf, fetched 2026-08-23) + City Attorney's impartial analyses compilation (Nov 2026 Impartial Analyses.pdf). Revenue estimates are the City's own, quoted from the impartial analyses. Measure-letter assignments per the City's Ballot Measures page. Median-home costs are DERIVED downstream from these rates x the citywide median building sqft (tax_incidence block) — not official figures; no official per-household cost exists for Y or Z.

measures.name: Sales tax (Transactions & Use Tax)
measures.mechanism: 0.50% transactions-and-use tax citywide (aggregate rate to 10.75%); operative Apr 1 2027
measures.notes: Sec.7.34.150 authorizes pledging the revenue to bonds (securitizable). The ballot's only direct deficit fix.

measures.name: Charter amendment (elections & procedures)
measures.mechanism: Filing fees to Elections Code level; Fair Elections Fund admin cap $250k->$400k/4-yr cycle; recall/vacancy/referendum procedure updates
measures.notes: Existing $4/resident/yr GF appropriation to the Fair Elections Fund unchanged.

measures.name: Rent ordinance amendments
measures.mechanism: Exemption status locked to current tenancy start; banked-AGA increases capped 10%/12mo; tenant-association threshold 10->5 units; fee due-date to Sep 30; nonprofit fee waivers
measures.revenue_note: no city revenue; Rent Board fee-funded

measures.name: Arts parcel tax (Arts & Creative Economy)
measures.mechanism: $0.07 per sq ft of improvements, residential = commercial; senior/very-low-income owner-occupant + religious/educational + regulated-affordable exemptions
measures.fund: special (Arts Vitality Fund: 75% performing-arts rescue grants, 10% capital, 5% arts grants, 5% festivals, 5% admin)
measures.notes: Proponent legal-defense indemnification clause; highest-vote-wins conflicting-measures clause; UC/government entities ineligible for grants.

measures.name: Public-bank parcel tax
measures.mechanism: Up to $0.06/sq ft residential + $0.09/sq ft non-residential improvements; very-low-income owner exemption; capitalizes a public bank (Gov. Code 57600)
measures.escalator: mandatory annual: greater of Bay Area CPI or CA per-capita income growth ('shall increase... by up to' - ambiguous drafting)
measures.fund: special (bank capitalization; fallback to direct city lending if no charter by Jun 30 2033; City Auditor audit >=3-yearly)
measures.notes: State caps public-bank charters at 2/yr, 10 total; DFPI approval + feasibility study required. Highest-vote-wins clause vs measures funding the same uses.

measures.name: Soda tax 1c -> 2c (general -> special)
measures.mechanism: 2c/fl-oz distributor excise on sugar-sweetened beverages, replacing (suspending) the existing 1c GENERAL tax; CPI escalator from 2028 capped 5%/yr; small-retailer (<$100k receipts) exemption
measures.duration: no sunset; old 1c tax auto-revives if struck down
measures.fund: special (<=15% admin, >=42.5% CBO/dept grants, >=42.5% may go to BUSD; 9-member expert panel)
measures.notes: NET GENERAL FUND LOSS ~$1.2M/yr: the existing 1c tax's unrestricted GF revenue is suspended and replaced by restricted special-fund revenue — the only measure on the ballot that reduces GF revenue.
